title: NovaHack CTF
description: NovaHack is a beginner-friendly Capture The Flag competition designed for first-year CSE/IT students exploring cybersecurity for the first time. 10 jeopardy-style challenges covering HTML forensics, metadata analysis, steganography, encoding, debugging, brute force, and web forensics.

title: Hire Your Research Agent
description: A hands-on workshop on building autonomous research agents using large language models and agentic frameworks. Participants built AI-powered pipelines that browse the web, summarize papers, and generate structured research reports — no prior ML experience required.
